Messages.Author: Ashur
Messages.Body:
I am a big fan of the immersion in the game (imagine stuff like "Koko gets a chainsaw and a hawg and rushes Carna in her Ankara Citadel") as well as the lore of Vampire The Masquerade. I guess this is because I´m not just a gamer - I´m a rpg nerd gamer. Anyway, these things give VtES an extra dimension in my opinion.

Sadly, WW have not always promoted those bits of the game. Instead they sometimes went for a "It´s just a bunch of cards, cards needs to be designed, it doesn´t matter what they´re called and what seem to happen in game"-approach.

A good example of this is the Inconnu event cards. What really happens when those cards are dropped on the table?

- Inconnu Tutelage: "A Methuselah may spend four transfers and remove a vampire in his or her uncontrolled region from the game to search for any card in his or her library and put it in his or her hand (discarding and shuffling afterward)." OK, so the Inconnu have some dubious methods for getting things done. They sacrifice vamps. Now, their secret seems to be out! Suddenly every player can do this? Shouldn´t this more likely have been a master card?

- Narrow Minds: "Do not replace until your untap phase. Minion cards that change the target of a bleed cost an additional blood or life." Eeeeh? The Inconnu suddenly induce headache in ... everyone that bounces bleeds? I don´t get it.

- Urban Jungle: "Blood hunt referendums get an additional 2 votes against the referendum." What has this to do with the Inconnu?! The secret Golconda/demon sect is suddenly promoting diablerie. For everyone. I don´t get it.

Some of these things might have something to do with me not being up to date with the Vampire lore, please inform me.

I guess I´m also confused why the Inconnu trait became a event trait instead of a vamp trait. Anyone know anything?

"My strategy? Luck is my strategy, of course."

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: I would think it was eventually going to become a vampire trait also if the game would have continued, there are quite a few keywords that don't mean anything at the moment.

Messages.Author: Brum
Messages.Body:
It might have been one of those things LSJ left open for future release integration. Like the Bahari thing.
Other examples of apparently pointless things that got some type of release cards to context were the Regent card (turned into a proper title),
Sabbat Inquisitor trait and the release of the Treaty of Laibach after the release of a vampire who could fetch it.

Since the Inconnu are what's left of the 4th generation Ventrue and some other really old kindred, who were very, very powerful, I don't think they would be released.
I mean, 7 or 8 new 's...

Another way to go would be to release new, non-cannon vampires that could have smaller capacities and power.
Don't know. Probably never will.

I have no problem with more 11 caps, as long as they are balanced (hideous drawbacks, grouping numbers etc). But sure, it is a game design challenge.
